newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Ciba, Sandoz ease in pre-bourse.
newsitem.headline: Ciba, Sandoz ease in pre-bourse.

text.p: Shares in Swiss chemicals and pharmaceuticals groups Sandoz AG and Ciba-Geigy AG fell in pre-bourse trading on six month results that were below expectations.
At 0730 GMT the registered shares of Ciba were quoted 12 francs lower at 1,551/1,555 from Tuesday's 1,565 franc closer and Sandoz was quoted at 1,454/1,458, down 12 francs from 1,469.
Dealers said the six-months figures of Ciba and Sandoz were lower than expected and there was some switching into Roche, which reported six month results on Tuesday.
